svg.title: Campus Cards · Set 04 · Irvine · 12/12 Low Tide (Common)
svg.desc: When the water pulls back: anemones, snails, a crab that saw you first. Look, then leave it be. Unofficial. An independent PointCast art project about places. Not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by the University of California or any campus. No university logos, seals, mascots, or marks are used.
